examples: All external sources live in packages/ingest/src/adapters/* implementing SourceAdapter.
Normalize through upsertEvents / upsertShowtimes — never write source-specific SQL in the API.
New cities or sources = new adapter + schedule entry.
Web and future iOS only talk to apps/api /v1/*.
Keep ranking in @bored/shared so clients stay thin.
Event and showtime ticket/register links use GET /r/e/:id and /r/s/:id — never raw third-party URLs in primary CTAs.
Affiliate + UTM rewriting lives in packages/shared/src/affiliate.ts; destinations always resolve from DB.
User runs servers in their own Cursor terminals: pnpm dev:api (:4000) and pnpm dev:web (:3000). Prefer hot reload; do not restart after ordinary edits.
Agents must NEVER start, restart, stop, kill, or free ports for the local stack (no pnpm dev / dev:restart / pkill / nohup) unless the user explicitly asks in that message.
If the site is down, tell the user what to run in their terminals — do not take over the servers.
Don't commit or git add until explicitly asked.

rules.description: Ship to prod — rebuild, migrate, secrets, re-ingest
examples: Follow docs/ship-checklist.md when making prod match local after multi-agent work.
Never Redeploy stale images; railway up to rebuild api+web+ingest together for schema/feed/adapter changes.
Do not dump local DB to Railway — migrate + one-shot missing adapters (instagram/youtube via railway ssh).
Sync renewed IG_ACCESS_TOKEN to Railway env and prod app_settings; run pnpm ship:preflight before calling done.

meta.projectContext: SF Bay Area + Chicago events discovery — feed quality first, multi-user ready.
